# [Feature Name] Implementation Plan

> This plan is the implementation handoff. It should be concise, but contain
> the context needed to execute and verify the work. Decisions and rationale
> that already belong to a spec, ADR, RFC, or decision record must be
> referenced, not copied.

> **For agentic workers:** Use subagent-driven development to implement this
> plan task-by-task. The executable task registry is
> `docs/jobs/NNNN-<feature-name>/super-plan.json` and is the single source of
> truth for task ownership, dependencies, steps, and acceptance criteria.
